owners.label: Decipher
owners.description: Resonance Skill Overshock inflicts 10 stacks of Electro Flare on the target it damages.

owners.label: Regression
owners.description: When Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, gain 20% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 20s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.

owners.label: Rumbling Thunders
owners.description:
The incoming Resonator gains Electro Core for 20s or until the Resonator is switched out. After Resonators with Electro Core inflict Negative Statuses, their Electro Core is consumed, and they gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.
Casting Outro Skill ends the Apex Resonance state and clears all Thunder Rage.

owners.label: Celestial Ingenuity
owners.description: While casting Normal Attack and Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds, gain increased resistance to interruption for 0.5s.

owners.label: Thousandfold Artifice
owners.description: Inflict 5 stacks of Electro Flare on the targets hit after Resonance Liberation Ultimate Tactics deals damage.

owners.label: Alchemy of Wonders
owners.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Overshock is increased by 20%.

owners.label: Earthquaking Rumble
owners.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Ultimate Tactics is increased by 20%.

owners.label: Principle of Change
owners.description: Crit. DMG is increased by 20% while in Apex Resonance.

owners.label: Mind's Depths in a Casket
owners.description: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds and Thunder Bane is increased by 20%.

owners.label: Overshock Team ATK
owners.description: Pressing Resonance Skill Overshock clears all Electric Surge and grants Resonators in the team 10% ATK for 20s.

owners.label: Electric Core
owners.description: The incoming Resonator gains Electro Core for 20s. When Resonators with Electro Core inflict Negative Statuses, consume Electro Core to gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.

owners.label: Apex Resonance
owners.description: During Apex Resonance, Crit. DMG is increased by 20%.
